commands: dist CSP hash and asset inspection
outcomes: Replaced the 874.71 KB TTF with a 47.82 KB Latin WOFF2 while retaining every non-ASCII codepoint used by the page.
Removed Plausible and kept the Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights React integrations as the only observability path.
Added security headers, a hash-based CSP compatible with the inline JSON-LD, immutable hashed-asset caching and a permanent www-to-apex redirect.
Updated commercial Open Graph, Twitter and Organization metadata and added a 1200x630 SVG social card.
Production build passed with 69.14 KB gzip JS and 47.82 KB font output.
residual_risks: Vercel headers and redirect require deployed-host verification; no deployment was performed.
Social crawlers should be checked against the SVG card after deployment because local build cannot prove provider previews.
